agencies.name: Environmental Conservation Department (ECD)
agencies.role: Myanmar's counterpart to Thailand's Pollution Control Department in cooperation on haze monitoring and data sharing.

monitoring.text: In May 2026 Thailand's PCD director-general cited Myanmar's limited air quality monitoring infrastructure and incomplete environmental databases as major challenges, and Thailand agreed to help Myanmar build online haze reporting.
According to Myanmar government data cited by PCD, Myanmar reduced wildfire hotspots by 12 percent in 2025 compared with 2024.

seasonalPattern.text: ASMC's alerts for the northern ASEAN and Mekong region typically run from about December to May.

policy.text: Myanmar and Thailand agreed to integrate monitoring platforms and share air pollution data under a long-term regional strategy.

openQuestions: Whether Myanmar publishes an official air quality index or station data is unknown.
No official public data source has been identified.

sources.title: Thai-Myanmar plan to link platforms and share haze data
